# Savvo

> Savvo is the investor CRM for founders raising a round. Run your raise without a spreadsheet: type what you remember after every pitch, and Savvo tracks who you met, who is going cold, and who is waiting on a follow-up. After the round closes, it keeps every relationship alive: hires, board, customers, and your broader network.

Savvo is built for startup founders managing investor pipelines, and more broadly for anyone whose network is their most valuable professional asset (VCs tracking dealflow, community builders, relationship-first sales professionals).

How it works: you type a quick note like you'd text a friend ("Met Sarah Chen at Founders Dinner, partner at Sequoia, wants Q2 metrics"). AI extracts the name, company, role, how you met, and next steps into structured contact data. Every contact gets a color-coded health score based on when you last interacted (green is active, red is at risk), and a daily digest email tells you each morning who needs attention.

Key capabilities:

- Natural language contact capture with AI extraction
- Relationship health scores, color-coded by freshness
- Semantic search over your network ("who do I know in healthcare AI?")
- Daily digest emails listing relationships that need attention
- AI follow-up drafts based on your interaction history
- Follow-up cadences (weekly, monthly, quarterly, or custom), scheduled one-off follow-ups, and snooze
- CSV and Google Contacts import with column mapping and automatic deduplication
- Google Calendar sync that detects meetings and adds attendees
- LinkedIn URL import
- AI intro suggestions across your network

Pricing: Free plan at $0/month (50 contacts, health scores, natural language input, 5 smart searches per month, weekly digest). Pro at $8/month or $75/year (unlimited contacts, unlimited search, AI follow-up drafts, imports, calendar sync, daily digest). Team plan ($12/user/month) is coming soon. No credit card required to start.

Privacy: Savvo never sells your contact data or shares it with other users. AI providers process data only for features you choose, and OpenAI API inputs and outputs are not used to train OpenAI models by default. All integrations (Google sync, imports, calendar) are opt-in. Per-user data isolation is enforced with row-level security, and you can export everything or delete your account at any time.
